intro: From April 13 to August 21, 2026, ZCyberNews covered 25 supply-chain-attack incidents, with 18 rated high and 7 critical. GlassWorm, TeamPCP, and APT37 were observed across technology, software development, cybersecurity, and enterprise software sectors, affecting Global, China, and South Korea. These cases highlight risks to enterprise environments, though specific CVE identifiers were not listed in this archive. The reporting focuses on how such attacks compromise trusted distribution channels, with the affected regions and sectors underscoring the broad reach of these campaigns.
